lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: Start a line or polygon walk with sound disabled; check the live sketch before saving and after full/lite style reload
Start point creation; verify every walk control is disabled already in the layer chooser
Create point geometry, open its form and camera, background/reopen, then fail a Save and recreate the process
During point creation try queued notification Resume, Finish and Discard; simulate a GPS gap
Save or explicitly cancel the point; verify the same walk survives and its controls unlock, with explicit reconnection if paused
Finish the walk; verify the final acknowledged geometry preserves all members/holes and remains recoverable after a validation or form failure
value.expected: Normal map menus and independent walk preview remain available. Point creation owns the foreground editor without stopping GNSS. No UI or backend command controls the walk while the point token exists; lifecycle and errors retain that token. Successful point Save or explicit Cancel unlocks only its own session. Finish does not restart after cold launch.
